title: hopea brevipetiolaris
intro: Hopea brevipetiolaris, commonly known as  Borneo ironwood or Belian, is a species of plant in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Hopea brevipetiolaris include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as an analgesic and anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include its rich content of flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
